works.body:
你好我喜欢你的艺术！我想用你的跳跃赤壁风格来创作我的角色！

哈特是龙的混血儿，外表冷漠，但热情而混乱。他弹着一把电吉他，这把吉他也可以作为他的武器。他喜欢勘察未开发的地形，并花很多时间玩音乐。他有黑色的头发和绿色的眼睛。身高 174 厘米。

主题：音乐设备和 CD、技术、末世后的城市与杂草丛生的树叶、故障、漂浮的 HUD 面板，整体审美类似于 Arknight

构图和诠释由您决定。请自由发挥！  谢谢！

https://www.notion.so/vani0x0/Hitori-Hart-Hart-280509103a5180eab81cc439d3b39c2f

Hi! Nice to meet you, and thank you so much for the lovely compliment! ♡

I'm really happy that you praised my OC Shiranui-san and showed interest in drawing him!
I'd absolutely love to request a chibi illustration of my OC.

PoeMArt-sama’s chibi artworks are incredibly beautiful and cute, and among them, this framed-art style piece is especially wonderful:
https://skeb.jp/@Poe_M_Art/works/75

If you would be willing to draw Shiranui-san in this framed-art style, I would be thrilled!

Here is the folder with his references:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1M4Yd2lBK6RoEVqsX_eUdQSuPi6265Wkp

Thank you so much for this wonderful opportunity.
I would be very grateful if you could consider my request (*ᴗˬᴗ)♡
